title: Cmd-B, Shift-Cmd-E and Cmd-F through debug.key with the plain Chromium page window made key (key_window page): does the page-first unhandled-key path run them; values recorded
why: reopen-f4 unhandled-key (after page-unhandled-cmd-b, STATUS 8229): with the shell window key the router runs Cmd-B at once and the page-first path never runs; on a person's Mac the page window is key (#32789). This makes the page window key the app's own way (DebugKey+Sequence makeKey) and posts the keys to the app's event queue.
source: REOPEN VIDEO for reopen-f4 (unhandled-key sub-agent a7ef7985776024ba0)
